sloka: तवामरसुतप्रख्य तर्तुम् सागरगाम् नदीम् ।नौरियम् पुरुषव्याग्र! ताम् त्वमारोह सुव्रत! ॥२-५२-९॥
transliteration: tavāmarasutaprakhya tartum sāgaragām nadīm ।nauriyam puruṣavyāgra! tām tvamāroha suvrata! ॥2-52-9॥

translations.english: O best among men, renowned like a god's son and constantly engaged in vows, here is the boat for you to cross the Ganga flowing into the sea. Do board it.
